questions.sourceBook: Magee, Orthopedic Physical Assessment; Kisner & Colby, Therapeutic Exercise; Brukner & Khan, Clinical Sports Medicine (chapter-level reference; cross-checked with Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination, 2e)

questions.question: A toe-raising spring (Klenzak) is used for:
questions.explanation: A spring-loaded dorsiflexion assist built into a calliper.
questions.sourceBook: Magee, Orthopedic Physical Assessment; Kisner & Colby, Therapeutic Exercise; Brukner & Khan, Clinical Sports Medicine (chapter-level reference; cross-checked with Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination, 2e)

questions.question: A SOMI brace is a:
questions.explanation: Used for cervical injuries and after surgery.
questions.sourceBook: Magee, Orthopedic Physical Assessment; Kisner & Colby, Therapeutic Exercise; Brukner & Khan, Clinical Sports Medicine (chapter-level reference; cross-checked with Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination, 2e)

questions.question: Marked lateral rotation of a transfemoral prosthesis at heel strike may be caused by:

options.C: Excessive toe-out alignment, inadequate suspension or weak medial rotators
options.D: A prosthesis that is too long only

questions.explanation: Check alignment and socket fit.
questions.sourceBook: Magee, Orthopedic Physical Assessment; Kisner & Colby, Therapeutic Exercise; Brukner & Khan, Clinical Sports Medicine (chapter-level reference; cross-checked with Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination, 2e)

questions.question: A hip flexion contracture in a transfemoral amputee typically causes:

options.B: Increased lumbar lordosis and shortened step length on the sound side
options.C: Longer step on the prosthetic side
options.D: Increased stability in the prosthetic knee

questions.explanation: Prevent by prone lying and stretching.
questions.sourceBook: Magee, Orthopedic Physical Assessment; Kisner & Colby, Therapeutic Exercise; Brukner & Khan, Clinical Sports Medicine (chapter-level reference; cross-checked with Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination, 2e)
